article: HugoでMarkdown内のHTMLを有効にする方法
findings: The old article claimed that config.toml was the only configuration file and linked to a retired documentation route. The current Hugo project configuration is hugo.yaml.
The official documentation says renderer.unsafe defaults to false, allows raw HTML in Markdown when true, and is unsafe unless the content is under the site owner’s control.
Restored the original publication date 2023-01-17 and removed the duplicate future date.

meaning.note: Compared the complete localized article with the Japanese source: Goldmark raw-HTML behavior, the default false value, YAML/TOML/JSON key path and examples, the trust-boundary warning, untrusted-input exclusion, and alternatives for complex layouts.

terminology.note: Checked localized Hugo, Goldmark, Markdown, raw HTML, renderer.unsafe, configuration-format, shortcode, and content-trust terminology for consistency; removed obsolete config.toml-only framing.

mathematics.note: The article contains no mathematical formulas or quantitative claims.

code.note: Parsed all YAML, TOML, and JSON examples in this translation and confirmed they produce the same markup.goldmark.renderer.unsafe=true configuration.
